All molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were performed using the Des- mond⁵⁶ package, within SMSS. Each molecule was placed in a cubic box with an edge length of 50 Å, and the OPLS4 50 force eld was applied to calculate the atomistic interactions. The simulations were performed in the canonical NVT⁵⁷ ensemble at a temperature of 300 K and a pressure of 1 atm. Temperature control was managed using the Nose–Hoover chain thermo- stat⁵⁸ with a relaxation time of 1.0 ps. A cut-off radius of 9 Å was set for Coulomb interactions. Each system underwent 100 ns of MD simulations, with trajectory frames saved at 100 ps inter- vals.
